clauses.label: sole paragraph
clauses.text:
]executive Order
Matthew E. Hanna, of Connecticut, now in the Embassy of the United
States at Mexico City, may be examined for a secretaryship in the diplomatic
service without reference to the Executive Order of April 21, 1915, that no
person shall be certified as eligible for appointment as a secretary in the
diplomatic service who is over thirty-five years of age.
